newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin must stay in hospital all week - Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin must stay in hospital all week - Kremlin.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, who is suffering from pneumonia, must stay in hospital until the end of this week, chief Kremlin doctor Sergei Mironov told a news conference on Wednesday.
"I think that he should stay in the Central Clinical Hospital...until the end of this week," Mironov said. Yeltsin, 65, was taken to hospital last Wednesday.
Yeltsin, who had a quintuple bypass operation on November 5, returned to the Kremlin only on December 23.
Doctors have said the pneumonia he is currently suffering from is not linked to the heart operation.
